prompt: A muscular adult male exudes sophisticated masculine elegance in a cream white double-breasted linen suit featuring metallic gold buttons and a brown and gold patterned pocket square tucked into the breast pocket, worn over a deeply unbuttoned white shirt. His short, wavy brown hair is styled back, and his serious face features a closed, neutral mouth and a downward gaze partially obscured by gold wire-rimmed sunglasses with brown tinted lenses. Standing directly facing the camera with slightly shifted weight, his right hand is elevated to his lower chest, with the thumb and index finger delicately pinching the small handle of a white ceramic espresso cup. The subject is positioned on an outdoor coastal balcony, standing near a weathered, warm sand-colored plaster ledge in the bottom right foreground characterized by rough, porous granular pitting. Behind him, the pristine, deep blue ocean stretches into the midground, its surface texture rendered into a smooth blur. Bathed in highly directional, warm golden natural sunlight striking from a 45-degree angle at the top left, the scene dramatically contrasts bright highlights on his right cheekbone, nose bridge, right shoulder, and the cup's rim against harsh, deep black shadows cast under his chin, deep inside his unbuttoned shirt, by the lapels onto his chest, and by his fingers onto the cup. The complementary color palette of cream white, deep ocean blue, and warm bronze creates a mood of sun-drenched, quiet luxury. Shot in a highly realistic editorial digital photography style heavily influenced by Italian Riviera menswear and old money aesthetics, utilizing an 85mm portrait lens with a wide aperture around f/2.0 to ensure a tack-sharp subject against a shallow depth of field, enhanced by high-contrast warm color grading and subtle film grain, entirely framed in a 9:16 aspect ratio.
